blocks.title: Electrophilic addition
blocks.text: Woh reaction jis mein alkene ke double bond par electrophile jora jaye electrophilic addition reaction hai.

Alkene ka C=C zyada electron density ka ilaqa hai aur is liye electrophiles ke hamle ke liye aasan. Alkene electrophile se react kar ke carbocation intermediate deta hai, jo phir nucleophile se react karta hai; Figure 11.13 ke aam mechanism mein X+ electrophile aur Y- nucleophile hai. Yahan sirf halogen addition aur hydrogen halide addition ke mechanisms parhe jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: ethene, double bond shaded, double bond se X+ (electrophile) ki taraf surkh curly teer; phir X-CH2-CH2+, surkh teer 'carbocation' ki taraf. Neeche: carbocation X-C-C+ aur Y- (nucleophile), Y- se C+ tak surkh curly teer; phir X-CH2-CH2-Y.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.13: Electrophilic addition ka aam mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1. Halogenation

Halogenation chlorine ya bromine ka addition hai. Jab bromine water (surkh-bhoora) carbon tetrachloride jaise inert solvent mein ethene mein dala jaye to us ka rang foran khatam ho jata hai; yeh reaction unsaturation pehchanne ke liye istemal hota hai: CH2=CH2 + Br2 se BrCH2-CH2Br. Mechanism: (i) Br2 non-polar hai, magar double bond ke qareeb aane par zyada electron density Br-Br electron pair ko qareeb wale bromine se door dhakelti hai, jo halka musbat ho jata hai (induced dipole) aur electrophile ka kaam karta hai; (ii) pi electrons musbat bromine par hamla karte hain, jo C=C se electron pair qubool karta hai, bohat reactive carbocation intermediate dete hue; (iii) carbocation Br- (nucleophile) se react kar ke 1,2-dibromoethane deta hai (Figure 11.14).

blocks.alt: Ethene, double bond shaded, khokhla teer 'High area of electron density, Non-polar molecule'. Br2 do dashed electron badalon ki shakal mein: delta+ Br ('Electrophile') aur delta- Br: ('Induced Dipole'); likha hai 'The double bond repels the electrons away from the closest Br atom'.
blocks.caption: Qadam (i): double bond Br2 mein dipole paida karta hai (kitab ke safha 260 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Mechanism: ethene, C=C se Br-Br ke delta+ Br tak curly teer, aur Br-Br bond se delta- Br tak curly teer; ethene ke neeche surkh khokhla teer 'Donates electrons pair to Br+'. 'Room Temp.' wala teer primary carbocation H-CH(Br)-CH(+)-H tak, jis par :Br- hamla karta hai (curly teer); neeche teer 1,2-dibromoethane tak, har carbon par Br.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.14: Ethene aur Br2 ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle khaake mein Br2 khud non-polar hai; ethene ka double bond (zyada electron density) qareeb wale Br ke electrons ko door dhakelta hai, is liye qareeb wala Br delta+ (electrophile) aur door wala delta- ban jata hai: induced dipole. Phir pi electrons delta+ Br par hamla karte hain, Br-Br bond ke electrons doosre Br ke paas chale jate hain (Br-), aur carbocation banta hai jis par Br- jur kar 1,2-dibromoethane banata hai.
2. Hydrohalogenation

Alkene kamre ke darja hararat par khushk gaseous hydrogen halide se react kar ke halogenoalkane deta hai: CH2=CH2 + HBr se CH3CH2Br, bromoethane. Hydrogen halides mustaqil dipoles wale sab se saade polar maddon mein se hain jo alkenes par jurte hain (Figure 11.15); HBr, HCl, HI aur HF sab C=C ke paar ek hi tarah jurte hain, rate HF se HI tak barhti hui. Product is par munhasir hai ke alkene symmetrical hai ya unsymmetrical.

blocks.alt: H-Br: H par delta+, Br par delta-, dipole teer Br ki taraf. H hare daire mein, 'Electrophile'. Dabbe: 'Pulls the electrons more strongly towards itself' (Br); 'Has lower electronegativity than Br so is electron deficient' (H).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.15: HBr molecule ki polarity (kitab ki Figure 11.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Symmetrical alkenes par addition: ethene ke saath sirf ek product mumkin hai. Nucleophilic pi bond hydrogen halide ke hydrogen par hamla karta hai, hydrogen bromide bromide ion deta hai, aur ethene double bond wale carbons mein se ek par hydrogen jur kar carbocation banti hai; phir bromide ion (nucleophile) carbocation par hamla kar ke bromoethane deta hai (Figure 11.16).

blocks.alt: Ethene, C=C se H-Br ke delta+ H tak curly teer, aur H-Br bond se Br tak curly teer. Teer carbocation H-CH2-CH(+)-H tak, jis par :Br- hamla karta hai; neeche teer 1-Bromoethane (alkyl halide) tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.16: Ethene par HBr ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Unsymmetrical alkenes par addition: nazriyati taur par do products mumkin hain. Propene ke saath HBr 2-bromopropane ya 1-bromopropane de sakta hai; tajurbati taur par bara product 2-bromopropane aur chhota 1-bromopropane hai. Markovnikov ka usool lagoo hai: jab polar reagent unsymmetrical alkene par jure to reagent ka manfi hissa us double bond wale carbon se jurta hai jis par hydrogens ki tadaad kam ho. Mechanism (Figure 11.17): (i) pi electrons H-Br ke juzvi musbat sire par hamla karte hain, jo heterolytic taur par toot kar bromide ion deta hai; hydrogen zyada hydrogens wale double bond carbon par jurta hai, secondary (2 degree) carbocation banate hue; (ii) bromide ion secondary carbocation par hamla kar ke bara product deta hai, jabke chhota product primary carbocation par hamle se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Propene, sab bonds ke saath; us ke C=C se H-Br ke delta+ H tak curly teer aur H-Br bond se Br tak. Room Temp: H CH2 sire par jurta hai, secondary carbocation CH3-CH(+)-CH3, :Br- hamla, 2-bromopropane (major product). Neeche wala rasta: H darmiyani carbon par, primary carbocation CH3-CH2-CH2(+), :Br- hamla, 1-bromopropane (minor product).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.17: Propene par HBr ka electrophilic addition mechanism (kitab ki Figure 11.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Propene par H do jagah jur sakta hai. Agar H CH2 wale sire par jure to beech wale carbon par secondary carbocation banta hai, jo do alkyl groups ki wajah se zyada mustahkam (stable) hai; is liye 2-bromopropane bara (major) product hai. Agar H beech wale carbon par jure to primary carbocation banta hai jo kam stable hai, is liye 1-bromopropane chhota (minor) product hai. Yahi Markovnikov ka usool hai.
3. Hydrogenation

Hydrogenation catalyst (Ni ya Pt) ki maujoodgi mein 250 se 300 degrees C par alkene par molecular hydrogen ka addition hai jo saturated compound deta hai: CH2=CH2 + H2 Ni par CH3CH3 deta hai. Sanati paimane par yeh reaction vegetable oil ko margarine (banaspati ghee) mein badalta hai.
4. Hydration

Gaseous alkenes zyada darja hararat aur dabao par ghaliz acid (H2SO4) ko catalyst bana kar steam se react kar ke alcohols dete hain: CH2=CH2 + H2O se C2H5OH. Hydrohalogenation ki tarah alkene carbocation intermediate banata hai, jis par phir OH- hamla karta hai.
5. Halohydration

Alkene pani ki maujoodgi mein halogen (bromine ya chlorine) se react kar ke halohydrin deta hai; ethene bromohydrin ya chlorohydrin deti hai: CH2=CH2 + Br2 + H2O se BrCH2-CH2OH, 2-bromoethanol (print mein '1-bromo-2-ethanol').
6. Epoxidation

Alkenes ki epoxidation oxygen wala teen-rukni cyclic ether deti hai, epoxide. Ethene mukhtalif oxidising agents se, ya molecular oxygen aur transition metal catalyst (Ag) se, jo seedha alkene se epoxide banata hai, ethylene oxide mein badli ja sakti hai. Epoxides acid hydrolysis se diols mein badalte hain: ethylene oxide H+/H2O ke saath ethane-1,2-diol deta hai.

blocks.alt: Ethene + O2, 'Ag' wala teer, epoxide (do CH2 carbons aur ek O ka teen-rukni halqa), 'H+/H2O' wala teer, ethane-1,2-diol H2C(OH)-CH2(OH).
blocks.caption: Ethene ki epoxidation aur epoxide ki hydrolysis (kitab ke safha 263 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 7. Ozonolysis

Ozonolysis ozone, O3, oxygen ke reactive allotrope, se alkenes ka oxidative tootna hai; yeh namaloom alkenes ki banawat pehchanne ke liye unhen chhote, aasani se pehchane jane wale tukron mein tor kar istemal hota hai. Alkenes ozone se react kar ke ozonides banate hain, jo (Zn/H2O se) carbonyl compounds (aldehydes ya ketones) mein reduce hote hain, aur yeh mazeed alcohols mein reduce ho sakte hain: C2H4 + O3 se C2H4O3, jo 2 CH2O (methanal) deta hai. Propene ethanal aur methanal deta hai, jo ethanol aur methanol mein reduce ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: 1-Propene H3C-CH=CH2 O3 ke saath ozonide deti hai: O-O, CH2, O aur H3C wale HC ka paanch-rukni halqa. Zn/H2O se ethanal (H3C-CHO) + methanal (HCHO), C=O ke saath; reduction se ethanol H3C-CH2-OH aur methanol CH3-OH.
blocks.caption: Propene ki ozonolysis (kitab ke safha 264 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke khaake mein propene se ozonide wala teer dono taraf (reversible) chhapa hai; ozonide ka banna ek taraf ka reaction hai, is liye yahan seedha teer hai. Ozonolysis double bond ko tor deti hai: double bond ke har carbon par C=O ban jata hai, is liye products dekh kar pata chalta hai ke double bond kahan tha.
8. Polymerisation

Polymerisation chhote reactive molecules (monomers) ke aapas mein jurne se bohat lambe molecules (polymers) ka banna hai. Addition polymerisation, jis mein kam az kam ek C=C wale bohat se monomers waahid product ke taur par lambi polymer zanjeerein banate hain, alkenes ke sab se aham addition reactions mein se hai aur plastics ki sanat ki bunyad. Doosre additions ki tarah har C=C ka pi bond toot-ta hai aur monomers naye C-C single bonds se jur jate hain; polymer bohat se dohraye jane wale units ka lambi zanjeer wala molecule hai. Ethene poly(ethene) deti hai, chloroethene poly(chloroethene), PVC.

blocks.alt: Do qataren. n ethene (H2C=CH2), 'Polymerization' teer, poly(ethene): murabba brackets mein -CH2-CH2-, neeche n; labels Monomer aur Polymer. n chloroethene (H2C=CHCl), 'Polymerization', poly(chloroethene) (PVC): brackets mein -CH2-CHCl-, n.
blocks.caption: Ethene aur chloroethene ki addition polymerisation (kitab ke safha 264 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke PVC wale repeating unit mein chlorine ki jagah sirf 'C' chhapa hai; sahi Cl hai (har doosre carbon par ek Cl). Polymerisation mein har monomer ka C=C khul kar single bond ban jata hai aur monomers ek doosre se jur jate hain.

Repeating unit atoms ka woh sab se chhota group hai jo yake baad deegre jur kar zanjeer banata hai, murabba brackets mein dikhaya jata hai; ek monomer se bane poly(alkenes) aur substituted poly(alkenes) mein yeh monomer hi hai jis ka C=C C-C mein badla ho.

blocks.alt: n ethene (monomer), teer, brackets mein poly(ethene) aur n (polymer), surkh teer, chaar CH2 carbons ki zanjeer sab H ke saath, do carbons ke neeche qaus 'Repeating unit'.
blocks.caption: Poly(ethene) ki repeating unit nikalna (kitab ke safha 265 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke poly(ethene) wali zanjeer ke khaake mein ek hydrogen atom chhapne se reh gaya hai. Zanjeer ka har carbon CH2 hai (do hydrogen), is liye oopar khaake mein tamam hydrogen banaye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke ozonolysis double bond ki jagah kaise batati hai, ethene ki ozonolysis likhein, aur but-2-ene ki epoxidation dein (Quick Check 11.8).
blocks.explanation: Ozonolysis molecule ko bilkul double bond par kaat-ti hai, aur har tukra apne carbons rakhta hai, to dono carbonyl products pehchanna bond ki jagah batata hai: ethene do methanals deti hai (CH2=CH2 + O3 se ozonide, jo Zn/H2O se 2 HCHO deta hai), jabke propene ethanal jama methanal deti hai. But-2-ene silver catalyst par oxygen se, ya peroxy acid se, 2,3-dimethyloxirane deta hai, woh epoxide jis mein oxygen do darmiyani carbons ko jorti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Electrophilic addition: electrophile pi electrons par hamla karta hai, carbocation banta hai, nucleophile mukammal karta hai. Br2 (induced dipole; bromine water be-rang: unsaturation ka test) 1,2-dibromoethane deta hai; HBr bromoethane; propene ke saath Markovnikov ka usool: H zyada H wale carbon par, zyada mustahkam secondary carbocation ke zariye, 2-bromopropane bara.

Nez hydrogenation (H2, Ni, 250-300 degrees C; oils se margarine), hydration (steam, H2SO4: ethanol), halohydration (Br2/H2O: bromoethanol), epoxidation (O2/Ag; acid hydrolysis se diol), ozonolysis (O3, Zn/H2O: carbonyls, C=C ki jagah), addition polymerisation (poly(ethene), PVC; repeating unit brackets mein).
